recognize_zh: 骨髓抽吸抹片中央有一顆大型組織球，細胞質豐富、淡藍灰色，內部布滿彎曲的條紋如「皺摺衛生紙」（crumpled tissue paper），核小且偏心，周圍為正常骨髓細胞，是典型的高雪氏細胞（Gaucher cell）。
features: Large histiocyte with abundant pale blue-gray cytoplasm
Cytoplasm with fibrillary, striated texture resembling crumpled tissue paper
Small, eccentric, round nucleus with condensed chromatin
Surrounding normal marrow elements: maturing myeloid precursors, segmented neutrophils, lymphocytes, and erythroid precursors
No cytoplasmic vacuolation or foamy change
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a large histiocyte with abundant pale blue-gray cytoplasm containing fine, wavy fibrillary striations imparting a crumpled tissue paper appearance, with a small eccentric nucleus. The surrounding marrow contains maturing granulocytic precursors, segmented neutrophils, lymphocytes, and erythroid precursors without increased blasts. No foamy or sea-blue histiocytes are seen in this field. Findings are consistent with a Gaucher cell; glucocerebrosidase enzyme assay or GBA gene testing is recommended to distinguish Gaucher disease from pseudo-Gaucher cells.

ddx.dx: Pseudo-Gaucher cells (CML, myeloma, thalassemia, MAC infection)
ddx.vs: Pseudo-Gaucher cells look similar but occur with a background neoplasm, hemolysis or infection and have normal glucocerebrosidase activity.
Niemann-Pick cells have finely vacuolated foamy (soap-bubble) cytoplasm rather than fibrillary striations.
Sea-blue histiocytes contain discrete deep blue granules on Wright-Giemsa rather than pale fibrillary cytoplasm.
